sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Presented as part of the OFF Programme of the 2026 Dakar Biennale and Partcours, Palimpsest of African Cities is the latest edition of the DIG WHERE YOU STAND programme initiated by the African Artists' Foundation and taking place in several venues in Dakar, Senegal, from the 20th of November 2026 to the 28th of February 2027. This group exhibition brings together artists, architects, photographers, filmmakers, and researchers to explore the forces, narratives, and everyday dynamics that shape contemporary African cities.
